showcase.tabs_desc:
1. Casual: A one-time task that disappears.
2. Habit: A continuous action to build a streak.
3. Routine: An extended period (like work), drawn as an arc.
showcase.time_desc: Tap to set the task time. Choose between a fixed civil time or a flexible astro time.
showcase.modes_desc:
1. Periods: Link to a specific prayer (e.g., 1st Suwaya of Asr).
2. Cumulative: Pick a Suwaya index from 0 to 47.
3. Civil: Standard clock time like a meeting.

support.title: Support the App
support.success_msg: Thank you so much for supporting Suwaya! Your badge has been activated successfully.
support.philosophy_msg:
Suwaya is not just an app; it is a philosophy of reconnecting with the natural rhythm of the day and finding blessing (Barakah) in time. The app will remain completely free, ad-free, and respects your privacy.

Your subscription here unlocks no hidden features—it serves as a "Badge of Honor" next to your name. It is pure support and belief in the idea, helping us cover hosting and development costs.
support.feature_bronze: Displays the Bronze badge next to the app name
support.feature_silver: Displays the Silver badge next to the app name
support.feature_gold: Displays the Gold badge next to the app name
support.feature_diamond: Displays the Diamond badge next to the app name
support.feature_support: Support the philosophy and project continuity
support.auto_renew_note: All subscriptions are monthly, but "Auto-Renew" is turned off by default to ensure your comfort—no future charges will occur without your consent.
